    If no "
    No Kings" protests (March 28, 2026) are scheduled near you, you can still participate by attending a virtual post-protest meeting on Tuesday, March 31, at 8 pm EDT, or by checking nokings.org/about-nk for updates, according to No Kings and this Mobilize page. The protests took place in many locations across the US. 
    Alternative Ways to Participate: 
    • Virtual Action: Join the "What's Next After No Kings 3?" virtual meeting on March 31, 2026, at 8 pm EDT.
    • Stay Informed: Follow updates from the organizers at No Kings.
    • Mass Call: Join the Indivisible Mass Call on Tuesday, March 31, to hear about the plan for sustained action. 
    The protests are aimed at resisting perceived authoritarian power grabs, with many events held in suburban and major city locations, as reported by CNN.
